title: After a no-landing onboarding (birth month picked last), the first tap on a row only moves About you down; the value page opens on the second tap
evidence: When the onboarding completes with no landing in this tab (the birth month picked last after the year; HealthTool.onboarding.test.tsx birthWithoutJump), About you stays up until its card is left. A press inside the card leaves nothing focused in Safari, so the leave is held (leavePending), and the next pointerdown outside the card runs leaveCard (widget-src/src/components/InputPanel.tsx leaveProfile :241-245; the document pointerdown/focusin listener :246-256). That pointerdown is the person's tap on a row: About you moves low under the finger, the rows shift, and the click does not reach the row, so its value page opens only on a second tap. Repro: real WebKit at 390 px (tools/webkit-verify.mjs) after the no-landing finish, then tap a row. Older behaviour, not from H71; H71 (PR 1508) adds the Waist and Blood Pressure rows to the rows it affects, as they replaced the first-time vitals card. A fix would run the leave after the click or keep the tapped row under the finger. (H74)
